title: athyrium eburneum
intro: Athyrium eburneum, commonly known as White Lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of White Lady fern include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it a promising treatment for various health issues. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
